parameters.jsCode:
// Build per-listing prompts for Gemma scoring.
// Pulls prefs from workflow static data set by 'Dedup + Hard Filter'.

const items = $input.all();
const staticData = $getWorkflowStaticData('node');
const prefs = staticData.prefs || { likes: [], dislikes: [] };

const sysPreamble = [
  'You are scoring a Montreal rental listing for a couple looking to live in Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie as their PRIMARY target neighborhood, with easy access to Mile End where Rebecca spends time.',
  '',
  'Hard requirements: 3+ bedrooms (counting dens/offices as bedrooms — typically listed as a "3 bedroom" or Quebec "5 1/2"). Max budget $3200/mo, ideal $2800/mo. Min 1.5 baths preferred but not required.',
  '',
  'They strongly prefer:',
  '- A house, semi-detached, bungalow, duplex, or triplex unit (NOT a small condo or modern build)',
  '- The Rue Masson strip in Rosemont — top target zone',
  '- The Maisonneuve Park / east Rosemont area — bonus for green space',
  '- The Beaubien metro corridor / Petite-Patrie border',
  '- 2-car parking ideal, 1-car or laneway parking acceptable',
  '- Backyard, basement, or terrace',
  '- Cafe / shop / farmers-market neighborhoods (the Mile End vibe in a quieter form)',
  '',
  'Sub-neighborhood ranking (highest to lowest preference):',
  '- Rue Masson area, Rosemont east, Vieux Rosemont (top)',
  '- Petite-Patrie, Beaubien strip',
  '- Mile End (Rebecca\'s favorite)',
  '- Plateau Mont-Royal, De Lorimier',
  '- Villeray, Jarry Park metro area',
  '- Outremont, Petite Italie, Little Italy, Parc-Extension',
  '- CDN-Outremont border (only Avenue Kent / UdeM area)',
  '',
  'Avoid: south shore (Longueuil, St-Hubert, Brossard), Laval, west island, far east Montreal, Verdun, NDG west of Vendôme.',
  '',
  'Score 0-100. 90+ for an ideal Rue Masson bungalow with backyard at $2,500. 75-90 for a strong 5 1/2 in Rosemont/Mile End/Plateau/Villeray with backyard or parking. 60-75 for a reasonable in-zone listing meeting basic criteria. 40-60 for borderline (CDN border, missing amenities, less ideal sub-zone). Below 40 for marginal cases that should still be ranked but low.'
].join('\n');

const out = [];
for (const it of items) {
  const l = it.json;
  const prompt =
    sysPreamble + '\n\n' +
    'PREFERENCES (learned from past feedback):\n' +
    'Likes: ' + JSON.stringify(prefs.likes || []) + '\n' +
    'Dislikes: ' + JSON.stringify(prefs.dislikes || []) + '\n\n' +
    'LISTING:\n' +
    'Source: ' + (l.source || 'kijiji') + '\n' +
    'Title: ' + (l.title || '') + '\n' +
    'Price: $' + (l.price ?? '?') + '/mo\n' +
    'Beds: ' + (l.beds ?? '?') + ', Baths: ' + (l.baths ?? '?') + ', Sqft: ' + (l.sqft ?? '?') + ', Type: ' + (l.property_type ?? '?') + '\n' +
    'Location: ' + (l.location || '?') + '\n' +
    'Description: ' + (l.description_full || l.description || '(none)') + '\n\n' +
    'IMPORTANT: Every string value you return MUST be in ENGLISH. If the listing is in French, translate it. Do NOT include any French in the output, not even as a prefix like "English below". '+
    'Return JSON with keys: score (integer 0-100), verdict (one short sentence in ENGLISH), highlights (array of short ENGLISH strings), concerns (array of short ENGLISH strings), title_en (the listing title translated to natural English; if already English, return it unchanged), description_en (the listing description translated to natural English, preserving concrete details like rooms, amenities, street names; if already English, return it unchanged; keep under 500 characters).';

  out.push({ json: { ...l, prompt } });
}
return out;

nodes.name: Gemma Score (per listing)
nodes.notes: Calls Mac Mini Ollama at 10.0.0.1:11434 (Thunderbolt bridge). Uses qwen3:14b with think:false (qwen3 reasoning mode returns empty {} under format:json; think:false fixes it). Replaces retired gemma4:e4b. neverError=true so a Gemma timeout doesn't kill the run — the next node falls back to heuristic-only for any item missing an LLM response.
